Hear back to back 6 minute presentations from the following presenters Enabling Petawatt AI Clusters with Real-time Energy Routing (RER) by Gerald Bode and Florian EngelNVMeNext Rearchitecting a Virtual NVMe Device for GPU-centric Storage Systems by Jaehoon Shim and Injae KangMillisecond-Scale Load Leveling and Grid Contingency Ride-Through at GW-Scale Future-Proofing for Emerging Grid Codes by M A Awal and Jason BarmannSingle-Stage Vertical 48V-to-Core Power Delivery for Future AI Processors by Zhenshuai Rong and Yingchao ChiFrom Guided Technicians to Lights-Out AI Factories A Machine-Verifiable Operations Layer by Nauman Rafique and Marco Pritoni
